envelope.description: Chunk stage for coverage and quality

body.title: Chunk stage for coverage and quality
body.summary: Coverage's 'judge' stage gets chunkCalls returning symbol-coverage findings only (findingKind 'symbol-coverage', each with a symbolId the call carries) plus notes per promised test; quality's returns today's findings plus descriptions [{ atomId, description }], one per carried atom. validate(answer, call) rejects a coverage finding that is not symbol coverage of a carried symbol, a note key or atom outside the call, and a quality description set not equal to the carried atoms (missing, repeated or foreign ids named in the reasons); withCorrection re-issues with the reasons. The single path keeps today's prompts and schemas.
acceptanceChecks: A coverage chunk finding that is not symbol coverage of a carried symbol is rejected and re-issued once with a correction note, then fails the review; promised-test findings come only from gather.
A quality chunk answer carries exactly one description for every atom the call carries, and no other; a missing, repeated or foreign description is rejected, re-issued once, then fails the review.
Under the limit s1's single path sends today's coverage and quality prompts and schemas unchanged.

tests.name: src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/code-review-gather.test.ts: 'a chunk answer with an unknown key, an atom outside its call's carries, or a coverage finding that is not symbol coverage of a carried symbol is rejected and re-issued with a correction note'
